summary: Spawns configured waves in order, of anything prefab-based.
overview: Configure waves in the Inspector and it spawns them one after another. Not tied to enemies — pickups, obstacles, anything prefab-based works the same way.

params.tuning: Chosen randomly per spawn, so a single point means everything appears in one place.
The breathing room between waves. In tower defence this is the build window.
Turn off when a game manager or a UI button should decide when waves begin.

gotchas.title: A wave finishing is not the same as its enemies dying
gotchas.body: It tracks spawning, not survival. "All waves complete" means everything has been spawned, which is why the tower-defence manager also checks the base is still alive.
